title: Grade 6 Math — Thu, Jun 19
description: Quadrilaterals — Day 4 of 5: Properties of quadrilaterals
subject: mathematics

questions.question: In a parallelogram, opposite sides are ___.
questions.explanation: By definition, opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal in length and parallel to each other.

questions.question: In a rectangle, the diagonals are ___.
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a rectangle are equal in length, but they are NOT perpendicular unless it is a square.

questions.question: In a rhombus, the diagonals ___.
questions.explanation: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles (90°), but they are not equal in length.

questions.question: In a square, the diagonals are ___.
questions.explanation: A square's diagonals are both equal in length AND perpendicular (90°) — combining rectangle and rhombus properties.

questions.question: Consecutive (adjacent) angles in a parallelogram are ___.
questions.explanation: In a parallelogram, any two consecutive angles are supplementary — they add up to 180°.

questions.question: In which quadrilateral do diagonals bisect each other at 90° but are NOT equal?
questions.explanation: In a rhombus: diagonals bisect each other at 90° but are not equal. In a square they are both 90° AND equal.

questions.question: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
questions.explanation: All four angles of a rectangle are 90°.

questions.question: Opposite angles in a parallelogram are ___.
questions.explanation: Opposite angles in a parallelogram are always equal to each other.

questions.question: The diagonal of a square divides it into two ___.
questions.explanation: A square's diagonal creates two triangles with two equal legs (sides of the square) and a 90° angle → isosceles right-angled triangles.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if ∠A = 70°, then ∠C = ___.
questions.explanation: Opposite angles in a parallelogram are equal. ∠A = ∠C = 70°.

questions.question: In parallelogram ABCD, if ∠A = 70°, then ∠B = ___.
questions.explanation: Consecutive angles in a parallelogram are supplementary. ∠B = 180° − 70° = 110°.

questions.question: Which property is common to BOTH a rectangle AND a rhombus?
questions.explanation: Both rectangle and rhombus have diagonals that bisect each other. Rectangle has equal diagonals; rhombus has perpendicular diagonals.

questions.question: In a kite, ___.
options: Both diagonals bisect each other equally
One diagonal bisects the other at right angles
questions.explanation: In a kite, one diagonal (the main axis) perpendicularly bisects the other diagonal, but is not itself bisected.

questions.question: Rectangle vs Rhombus — which statement is correct?
options: Rectangle has perpendicular diagonals; rhombus has equal diagonals
Rectangle has equal diagonals; rhombus has perpendicular diagonals
Both have equal and perpendicular diagonals
Neither has equal nor perpendicular diagonals
questions.explanation: Rectangle: diagonals are equal (not perpendicular). Rhombus: diagonals are perpendicular (not equal). Square has both.

questions.question: In a trapezium, the diagonals ___.
options: Are generally not equal and do not bisect each other equally
questions.explanation: In a general trapezium the diagonals are neither equal nor do they bisect each other equally (unlike a parallelogram).
